priorityList: Summon your pet before combat starts.
Use offensive racials (such as Berserking or Blood Fury) and combat potions when Bestial Wrath is ready or active.
Use active trinkets when Bestial Wrath is ready or active to maximize burst damage.
Use Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath's cooldown is less than one GCD away to maximize cooldown reduction.
Cast Kill Command if Bestial Wrath is on cooldown and the Sentinel's Nature's Ally buff is active.
Cast Kill Command if you have fewer than 3 stacks of the Apex Tier Set bonus to avoid capping resets.
Use Barbed Shot to maintain three stacks of Frenzy on your pet or to prevent the ability from reaching two charges.
Use Cobra Shot as a filler when Kill Command is on cooldown and you have excess Focus.
